review.imagery: Twenty-four project renders were visually reviewed. The current aerial cover supplies the card and hero. Twenty native brochure scenes span the exterior, balconies, home interiors, lobby, gym, spa, library, pools and outdoor leisure spaces. Three distinct current-gallery views add a tower angle, wider living room and rooftop pool. Duplicate website scenes, teal backgrounds and generic people photographs are excluded. Proposed fitout remains unit-unspecific. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Nine complete home sheets come from SAMANA’s brochure. Six building sheets come from a Dubai-P mirror of a SAMANA-branded revised plan pack. Its retail ranges and residential category averages are not whole-floor totals or areas assigned to a particular home drawing. The primary page’s duplex labels differ from the brochure. Confirm the approved unit, area and configuration. All nine official home sheets on physical pages 43–51 were individually reviewed. No numerical areas are printed on them. Both sky-villa drawings retain their two levels on one complete sheet. Six mirror sheets were individually reviewed, including their category-average panels and retail range. The branded mirror cover identifies this project. No broad average is silently assigned to a specific home, and the brochure’s three-bedroom sky-villa label is preserved despite the primary page’s different duplex label.
review.location: Complete original brochure map page 13 and travel panel page 11 were visually reviewed. The HTML-escaped DMS query was decoded before parsing. Its north/east coordinate converts to 25.094361, 55.325028 after six-place rounding, with steps and source hash saved. Regional travel differences remain explicit. No nearby project pin, road distance, live route or precise entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and original official brochure retain receipts, source bytes and SHA-256 values. The additional plan pack is explicitly a Dubai-P broker mirror. Native image origins, original full-sheet notices and separate physical PDF links remain available. Protected ownership, completed text research and historical commercial qualifications are preserved.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, resolution of inconsistent duplex labels across sources, approved unit fitout, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. Broker category averages remain separate from official home drawings.
